config.name: MTG_MCP_ENABLE_EDHREC
config.description: Enable EDHREC commander metagame backend (uses undocumented endpoints)

config.name: MTG_MCP_ENABLE_17LANDS
config.description: Enable 17Lands draft analytics backend for card ratings and archetype stats

config.name: MTG_MCP_ENABLE_BULK_DATA
config.description: Enable Scryfall bulk card data for rate-limit-free lookups (~80 MB download on first use)

config.name: MTG_MCP_SCRYFALL_RATE_LIMIT_MS
config.description: Minimum delay between Scryfall API calls in milliseconds

config.name: MTG_MCP_BULK_DATA_REFRESH_HOURS
config.description: Hours between Scryfall bulk data refreshes

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Health check — returns 'pong'.

tools.name: scryfall_search_cards
tools.description: Search for Magic cards using Scryfall syntax. Examples: "f:commander id:sultai t:creature", "o:destroy t:instant cmc<=3" See https://scryfall.com/docs/syntax for full syntax reference.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max cards to return (default 30, 0 for all)

params.name: query
params.description: Scryfall search query (e.g. 'f:commander id:sultai t:creature cmc<=3'). See scryfall.com/docs/syntax

tools.name: scryfall_card_details
tools.description: Get full details for a Magic card by exact or fuzzy name.

params.name: name
params.description: Card name — exact match by default (e.g. 'Muldrotha, the Gravetide')

params.name: fuzzy
params.description: Use fuzzy matching for approximate names (e.g. 'muldrotha' finds 'Muldrotha, the Gravetide')

tools.name: scryfall_card_price
tools.description: Get current prices for a Magic card. Prices update once per day.

params.name: name
params.description: Card name for price lookup (exact match)

tools.name: scryfall_card_rulings
tools.description: Get official rulings and clarifications for a Magic card.

params.name: name
params.description: Card name to get official rulings for (exact match)

tools.name: scryfall_set_info
tools.description: Get metadata for a Magic set by its code.

tools.name: scryfall_whats_new
tools.description: Find recently printed or released Magic cards. Searches Scryfall for cards released within the given number of days. Optionally filter by set or format legality.

params.name: days
params.description: Look back this many days for recent cards (minimum 1)

params.name: limit
params.description: Max cards to return (default 30, 0 for all)

params.name: format
params.description: Filter to cards legal in a format (e.g. 'standard', 'commander', 'modern')

params.name: set_code
params.description: Filter to a specific set code (e.g. 'mh3', 'lci')

tools.name: spellbook_find_combos
tools.description: Search for known combos involving a specific card. Optionally filter by color identity (e.g. "sultai", "BUG", "wubrg"). Returns up to `limit` combos with cards involved and results produced.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of combos to return

params.name: card_name
params.description: Card name to search for combos (e.g. 'Muldrotha, the Gravetide')

params.name: color_identity
params.description: Filter by color identity — name ('sultai'), letters ('BUG'), or 'wubrg'

tools.name: spellbook_combo_details
tools.description: Get detailed steps for a specific combo by its Spellbook ID. Use an ID from find_combos results (e.g. "1414-2730-5131-5256").

params.name: combo_id
params.description: Spellbook combo ID from find_combos results (e.g. '1414-2730-5131-5256')

tools.name: spellbook_find_decklist_combos
tools.description: Find combos present in (or nearly present in) a Commander decklist. Provide commander name(s) and a list of card names in the main deck. Returns combos that are fully included and those that are almost included.

params.name: decklist
params.description: List of card names in the main deck

tools.name: spellbook_estimate_bracket
tools.description: Estimate the Commander bracket (power level) for a decklist. Provide commander name(s) and a list of card names in the main deck. Returns bracket tag and any bracket-relevant findings.

params.name: decklist
params.description: List of card names in the main deck

tools.name: draft_card_ratings
tools.description: Get win rate and draft performance data for cards in a set. Key metrics: GIH WR (ever_drawn_win_rate), ALSA (avg_seen), OH WR (opening_hand_win_rate), IWD (drawn_improvement_win_rate). Note: 17Lands data skews toward above-average players (~56% baseline WR). Cards with <500 games may not have reliable data.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max cards to return (default 50, 0 for all)

tools.name: draft_archetype_stats
tools.description: Get win rates by color pair/archetype for a draft set. Note: start_date and end_date are required by the 17Lands API. Args: set_code: Three-letter set code (e.g. "LCI", "MKM", "OTJ"). start_date: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. end_date: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. event_type: Draft format — "PremierDraft" (default) or "TradDraft".

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required by 17Lands API)

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required by 17Lands API)

tools.name: edhrec_commander_staples
tools.description: Get the most-played cards for a commander with synergy scores and inclusion rates. Shows which cards are most commonly played with this commander and how synergistic they are (vs. generic popularity).

params.name: limit
params.description: Max cards per category (default 10, 0 for all)

tools.name: edhrec_card_synergy
tools.description: Get synergy data for a specific card with a specific commander. Shows how synergistic the card is with the commander compared to its general popularity, plus how many decks include it. Args: card_name: The card to check (e.g. "Spore Frog"). commander_name: The commander to check against (e.g. "Muldrotha, the Gravetide").

params.name: card_name
params.description: Card to check synergy for (e.g. 'Spore Frog')

params.name: commander_name
params.description: Commander to check synergy against (e.g. 'Muldrotha, the Gravetide')

tools.name: moxfield_decklist
tools.description: Fetch a full decklist from Moxfield by deck ID or URL. Returns the complete decklist organized by board (commanders, mainboard, sideboard, companions) with card names and quantities.

params.name: deck_id
params.description: Moxfield deck ID or full URL (e.g. 'abc123' or 'https://www.moxfield.com/decks/abc123')

tools.name: moxfield_deck_info
tools.description: Get metadata for a Moxfield deck (name, format, author, dates). Returns deck metadata without the full card list. Use ``decklist`` for the complete card list.

params.name: deck_id
params.description: Moxfield deck ID or full URL (e.g. 'abc123' or 'https://www.moxfield.com/decks/abc123')

tools.name: moxfield_search_decks
tools.description: Search public Moxfield decks by format, keyword, or sort order. Returns a paginated list of deck summaries with name, format, author, colors, and card counts.

params.name: query
params.description: Optional search text to filter decks by name or description

params.name: format
params.description: Format filter (e.g. 'pauper', 'commander', 'modern'). Leave empty for all formats.

tools.name: moxfield_user_decks
tools.description: List a user's public decks on Moxfield. Verifies the user exists, then searches for their public decks. Optionally filter by format.

tools.name: bulk_card_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Magic card by exact name using Scryfall bulk data. Returns full card details including mana cost, type, oracle text, colors, power/toughness, prices, legalities, and EDHREC rank. Case-insensitive.

params.name: name
params.description: Card name for exact lookup, case-insensitive (e.g. 'Sol Ring')

tools.name: bulk_card_search
tools.description: Search for Magic cards in Scryfall bulk data. Args: query: Substring to search for (case-insensitive). search_field: Field to search in -- "name", "type", or "text". limit: Maximum number of results to return (default 20).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

params.name: search_field
params.description: Field to search in -- 'name' (card name), 'type' (type line), or 'text' (oracle text)

tools.name: bulk_format_legality
tools.description: Batch legality check for cards in a specific format. Returns a markdown table showing the legality status of each card in the specified format. Handles common format aliases (e.g. 'edh' for 'commander').

params.name: cards
params.description: List of card names to check legality for

tools.name: bulk_format_search
tools.description: Search for legal cards in a specific format using natural language. Combines format legality filtering with name/type/text search and optional color identity, price, and rarity constraints. Results are sorted by EDHREC rank (most popular first).

params.name: query
params.description: Search query -- card name, type, or oracle text substring (e.g. 'flying creatures', 'destroy target')

params.name: color_identity
params.description: Color identity filter (e.g. 'sultai', 'WU', 'red'). Only returns cards within this identity.

tools.name: bulk_format_staples
tools.description: Find the most popular (staple) cards legal in a format. Ranking adapts to the format: singleton formats (Commander, Brawl, Oathbreaker) use EDHREC rank; competitive formats use MTGGoldfish tournament frequency when available, falling back to a mana-efficiency heuristic.

params.name: color
params.description: Color identity filter (e.g. 'sultai', 'WU', 'red'). Only returns cards within this identity.

params.name: ranking_mode
params.description: How to rank staples: 'auto' (default) picks the best mode for the format, 'edhrec' uses Commander popularity, 'competitive' uses a mana-efficiency heuristic, 'tournament' uses MTGGoldfish metagame fre

tools.name: bulk_similar_cards
tools.description: Find cards similar to a given card. Scores similarity based on shared keywords, type words, CMC proximity, and oracle text overlap. Optionally filter by format legality and price.

params.name: format
params.description: Format filter (e.g. 'commander', 'modern'). Only returns legal cards.

params.name: card_name
params.description: Name of the card to find similar cards for

tools.name: bulk_random_card
tools.description: Get a random Magic card, optionally filtered by format, color, type, and rarity. Returns full card details in the same format as card_lookup.

params.name: format
params.description: Format filter (e.g. 'commander', 'modern'). Only returns legal cards.

params.name: color_identity
params.description: Color identity filter (e.g. 'sultai', 'WU', 'red'). Only returns cards within this identity.

tools.name: bulk_ban_list
tools.description: Get the banned and restricted cards for a format. Returns alphabetically sorted lists of banned and restricted cards, including their type lines.

params.name: format
params.description: Format to check ban list for (e.g. 'commander', 'modern', 'standard')

tools.name: bulk_card_in_formats
tools.description: Show a card's legality across all Magic formats. Returns a table with the card's legality status in each format, ordered with the most common formats first.

params.name: card_name
params.description: Card name to check format legality for

tools.name: spicerack_recent_tournaments
tools.description: List recent tournaments for a format with dates, player counts, and IDs. Use the tournament ID from the results with ``tournament_results`` to see full standings and decklists.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of tournaments to return (default 10)

params.name: num_days
params.description: Number of days to look back (default 14)

tools.name: spicerack_tournament_results
tools.description: Get full standings and decklists for a specific tournament. Look up a tournament by its Spicerack ID. Use ``recent_tournaments`` first to find tournament IDs.

params.name: top_n
params.description: Number of top standings to show (default 8)

params.name: format
params.description: Format to search within (optional, helps narrow results)

params.name: num_days
params.description: Number of days to look back (default 30)

tools.name: spicerack_format_decklists
tools.description: Find top-performing decklists across recent tournaments for a format. Collects top-4 finishers with Moxfield decklists from recent events. Use ``moxfield_decklist`` to fetch the full card list for a deck.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of decklists to return (default 10)

params.name: num_days
params.description: Number of days to look back (default 14)

tools.name: goldfish_metagame
tools.description: Get the current metagame breakdown for a competitive format. Shows top archetypes with meta share percentages, deck counts, and estimated paper prices.

tools.name: goldfish_archetype_list
tools.description: Get a sample decklist for an archetype in a format. Returns deck metadata (author, event, result, date) and the full mainboard and sideboard card list.

tools.name: goldfish_format_staples
tools.description: Get the most-played cards in a format with deck inclusion percentages. Shows which cards appear most frequently across all archetypes in the format, with average copies played per deck.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of staples to return (default 20)

tools.name: goldfish_deck_price
tools.description: Get the estimated paper price for an archetype deck. Returns the total estimated cost of the deck based on current card prices from MTGGoldfish.

tools.name: commander_overview
tools.description: Comprehensive commander profile combining data from all available sources. Returns card details, top combos, EDHREC staples, and synergy scores. Degrades gracefully if optional sources (EDHREC, Spellbook) are unavailable.

tools.name: evaluate_upgrade
tools.description: Assess whether a card is worth adding to a specific commander deck. Returns card details, price, synergy score, and combos enabled for the caller to assess. Degrades gracefully if optional sources (EDHREC, Spellbook) are unavailable.

params.name: card_name
params.description: Card to evaluate for the deck (e.g. 'Spore Frog')

params.name: commander_name
params.description: Commander the deck is built around

tools.name: draft_pack_pick
tools.description: Rank cards in a draft pack using 17Lands win rate data. Provides GIH WR, ALSA, IWD stats, and color fit analysis based on current picks. Requires 17Lands to be enabled.

params.name: pack
params.description: List of card names currently in the draft pack

params.name: set_code
params.description: Three-letter set code for the draft format (e.g. 'LCI', 'MKM')

params.name: current_picks
params.description: Cards already drafted — enables color fit analysis when provided

tools.name: suggest_cuts
tools.description: Identify the weakest cards to cut from a commander decklist. Scores cards by synergy, inclusion rate, and combo membership. Degrades gracefully if EDHREC or Spellbook backends fail (uses whatever data is available).

params.name: decklist
params.description: List of card names in the deck

params.name: num_cuts
params.description: Number of cut candidates to suggest

params.name: commander_name
params.description: Commander the deck is built around

tools.name: card_comparison
tools.description: Compare 2-5 cards side-by-side for a specific commander deck. Shows mana cost, type, synergy, inclusion rate, combo count, and price for each card. Scryfall and Spellbook required; EDHREC optional.

params.name: commander_name
params.description: Commander the deck is built around

tools.name: budget_upgrade
tools.description: Suggest budget-friendly upgrades for a commander deck. Ranks EDHREC staples by synergy-per-dollar within the given budget ceiling. Requires EDHREC (for staples) and Scryfall (for prices).

params.name: budget
params.description: Maximum price per card in USD (e.g. 5.0 for cards under $5)

params.name: commander_name
params.description: Commander the deck is built around

params.name: num_suggestions
params.description: Number of upgrade suggestions to return

tools.name: deck_analysis
tools.description: Full decklist health check — mana curve, colors, combos, bracket, budget, synergy. Uses all available backends: Scryfall bulk data for rate-limit-free card resolution, Scryfall API as fallback, Spellbook for combos and bracket estimation, EDHREC for synergy scores. Degrades gracefully if optional backends are unavailable.

params.name: decklist
params.description: List of card names in the deck (99 cards for Commander)

params.name: commander_name
params.description: Commander the deck is built around

tools.name: set_overview
tools.description: Draft format overview — top commons/uncommons and trap rares. Uses 17Lands card ratings to provide a data-driven format breakdown. Requires 17Lands to be enabled.

params.name: set_code
params.description: Three-letter set code for the draft format (e.g. 'LCI', 'MKM')

tools.name: theme_search
tools.description: Find cards matching a theme — mechanical, tribal, or abstract/flavorful. Maps themes to oracle text patterns and searches bulk data. Groups results by relevance tier (strong match, moderate match, flavor match).

params.name: theme
params.description: Theme to search for — mechanical (aristocrats, voltron, tokens), tribal (goblin, merfolk), or abstract (music, death, ocean)

tools.name: build_around
tools.description: Find synergistic cards for 1-5 build-around cards in any format. Analyzes oracle text for key mechanics, searches for synergies, and checks combo potential. Groups results by role (enablers, payoffs, support).

params.name: budget
params.description: Maximum price per card in USD

tools.name: complete_deck
tools.description: Identify gaps in a partial decklist and suggest cards to fill them. Analyzes mana curve, card roles, and format-specific ratios, then suggests cards for underrepresented categories.

params.name: budget
params.description: Maximum price per suggested card in USD

params.name: decklist
params.description: Partial decklist — card names already chosen

tools.name: commander_comparison
tools.description: Compare 2-5 commanders head-to-head: stats, combos, staples, popularity. Side-by-side comparison table with mana cost, color identity, EDHREC rank, combo count, and shared/unique staples.

tools.name: tribal_staples
tools.description: Best cards for a creature type — lords, synergy pieces, and top members. Groups results by: lords/anthems, tribal synergy, best members, tribal support.

tools.name: precon_upgrade
tools.description: Analyze and upgrade a Commander precon — identify weakest cards, suggest replacements. Pairs each upgrade with a specific cut, explaining the synergy improvement.

params.name: budget
params.description: Maximum price per upgrade card in USD

tools.name: color_identity_staples
tools.description: Top cards across ALL commanders in a color identity. Uses EDHREC aggregated data when available, falls back to EDHREC rank from bulk data.

tools.name: sealed_pool_build
tools.description: Build 1-3 decks from a sealed pool using card quality and color pair analysis. Evaluates each 2-color pair, selects best cards, and suggests land splits. Uses 17Lands data when available for card quality scoring.

params.name: pool
params.description: Card names in the sealed pool (typically 84-90)

tools.name: draft_signal_read
tools.description: Analyze draft picks and recommend a direction based on color signals. Uses ALSA data to detect which colors are open (cards seen later than expected = open).

params.name: picks
params.description: Cards already drafted, in pick order

params.name: current_pack
params.description: Current pack contents — if provided, cards are ranked with signal context

tools.name: draft_log_review
tools.description: Review a completed draft — pick-by-pick GIH WR analysis and key decision points. Identifies where you could have taken a higher-WR card, pivot points, and overall draft grade.

params.name: picks
params.description: Cards drafted in order (pack 1 pick 1 through pack 3 pick 14)

params.name: final_deck
params.description: Final deck submitted — enables 'made the deck' analysis

tools.name: rotation_check
tools.description: Check Standard rotation status and identify which cards are rotating. Shows sets currently in Standard with rotation dates. If cards provided, identifies which are in rotating sets and suggests replacements.

params.name: cards
params.description: Card names to check for rotation — omit for general rotation info

tools.name: metagame_snapshot
tools.description: Get the current metagame breakdown for a competitive format. Shows top archetypes with meta share %, tier classification, and prices. Uses MTGGoldfish as primary source with Spicerack tournament data as fallback.

tools.name: archetype_decklist
tools.description: Get the stock decklist for a competitive archetype. Returns a full decklist (mainboard + sideboard) with deck metadata and total price when available. Archetype name is fuzzy-matched.

params.name: archetype
params.description: Archetype name (e.g. 'Boros Energy', 'Mono-Blue Terror') — fuzzy matched

tools.name: archetype_comparison
tools.description: Compare 2-4 competitive archetypes side-by-side. Shows price, colors, key cards, shared staples, and differences.

tools.name: format_entry_guide
tools.description: Get a beginner-oriented guide for entering a competitive format. Shows archetypes sorted by budget accessibility, cross-archetype staples (buy once, play everywhere), and format rules summary.

params.name: budget
params.description: Max budget in USD — filters archetypes to this price ceiling

tools.name: suggest_sideboard
tools.description: Suggest a 15-card sideboard for a competitive deck. Analyzes the main deck's weaknesses and recommends sideboard cards with per-card reasoning. Works with heuristic analysis alone; enhanced with MTGGoldfish frequency data when available.

params.name: decklist
params.description: Main deck card names (e.g. ['4 Lightning Bolt', '4 Goblin Guide'])

params.name: meta_context
params.description: Optional context about local metagame (e.g. 'heavy on Mono-Red and Affinity')

tools.name: sideboard_guide
tools.description: Get a specific sideboard in/out plan for a named matchup. Given a full 75 and a matchup archetype, produces specific boarding instructions with reasoning.

params.name: matchup
params.description: Matchup archetype name (e.g. 'Mono-Red Aggro') — fuzzy matched

params.name: decklist
params.description: Main deck card names (e.g. ['4 Lightning Bolt', '4 Goblin Guide'])

params.name: sideboard
params.description: Sideboard card names (e.g. ['2 Hydroblast', '3 Tormod\'s Crypt'])

tools.name: sideboard_matrix
tools.description: Generate a sideboard matrix for a deck across common matchups. Matrix shows which sideboard cards come IN/OUT/FLEX for each matchup. Auto-detects top matchups from metagame data or uses provided matchup list.

params.name: decklist
params.description: Main deck card names (e.g. ['4 Lightning Bolt', '4 Goblin Guide'])

params.name: matchups
params.description: Matchup names to include — omit to auto-detect from metagame data

params.name: sideboard
params.description: Sideboard card names (e.g. ['2 Hydroblast', '3 Tormod\'s Crypt'])

tools.name: deck_validate
tools.description: Validate a decklist against a format's construction rules. Checks legality, deck size, copy limits, color identity (Commander), singleton rules, and Pauper rarity. Returns VALID or INVALID with actionable error messages.

params.name: decklist
params.description: Card names, optionally prefixed with quantity (e.g. '4x Lightning Bolt' or 'Lightning Bolt')

params.name: commander
params.description: Commander card name (required for Commander format)

params.name: sideboard
params.description: Sideboard card names, same format as decklist

tools.name: suggest_mana_base
tools.description: Suggest a mana base for a decklist based on color pip distribution. Analyzes color requirements, recommends land count, and suggests format-legal dual lands. Handles hybrid and phyrexian mana.

params.name: decklist
params.description: Non-land card names in the deck

params.name: total_lands
params.description: Override total land count (default: auto-calculated from avg CMC)

tools.name: price_comparison
tools.description: Compare prices across multiple cards using Scryfall bulk data. Returns a markdown table with USD, USD foil, and EUR prices sorted by USD descending.

tools.name: rules_lookup
tools.description: Look up MTG Comprehensive Rules by number or keyword search. Returns matching rules with full text, parent context, and subrules.

params.name: query
params.description: Rule number (e.g. '704.5k') or keyword to search for

tools.name: keyword_explain
tools.description: Explain an MTG keyword with rules text, examples, and interactions. Returns the rules definition, reminder text, and up to 5 example cards from bulk data.

tools.name: rules_interaction
tools.description: Explain how two mechanics or cards interact under MTG rules. Returns relevant rules, step-by-step resolution, and common misconceptions.

tools.name: rules_scenario
tools.description: Resolve a game scenario step-by-step using MTG rules. Covers priority, stack resolution, state-based actions, and triggers with rule citations.

params.name: scenario
params.description: Game scenario to resolve (describe the board state and action)

tools.name: combat_calculator
tools.description: Calculate combat step-by-step with keyword interactions. Resolves declare attackers → declare blockers → damage steps → state-based actions. Looks up card keywords from bulk data if card names are provided.
